compliance.source: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 Datasheet, release 5 (build 2026-07-03, d4e0f1799616), chapter 1: RP2350A with 4 MB flash, micro-USB, SWD port and power supply – no transmitter

sources: pin names from the Raspberry Pi Pico 2 pinout (RP-008301-DS-1) and datasheet (RP-008299-DS); the EasyEDA symbol names the GP pins by all their functions, numbers TP2–TP6 like pins 2–6 and swaps SWCLK and SWDIO (symbol_differs)
Raspberry Pi Pico 2 datasheet: VSYS 1.8-5.5 V, keep the external load on 3V3(OUT) below 300 mA
core current 30 mA, regulator efficiency 85 %, GPIO output resistance 30 Ohm: assumptions

pin functions (G-15): pico-sdk 2.1.1, src/rp2350/hardware_regs/include/hardware/regs/io_bank0.h (IO_BANK0_GPIOn_CTRL_FUNCSEL_VALUE_* of GPIO0-28: SPI, UART, I2C, PWM), platform_defs.h (RP2350A: ADC_BASE_PIN 26), boards/pico2.h (TP4 = GPIO23 PICO_SMPS_MODE_PIN, TP5 = GPIO25 PICO_DEFAULT_LED_PIN: used on the module, no free function)

checked: 3V3_EN pulled up to VSYS on the module (100 kOhm)

notes: Behaviour model 'mcu' with the module's buck-boost regulator (VSYS -> 3V3).
